mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.8% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.8%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate output increases, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and rising residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals severe labor market contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During low industrial production growth (INDPRO < 95), supply chain disruptions intensify and corporate output contracts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
